text:
Maya: Quick poll — lunchtime vibe check: 'microwave opera' (people narrating beeps like a dramatic aria) or 'headphone symphony' (everyone quietly jamming in their own corner)? I’ll start: Microwave Opera :microphone: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Tom: Microwave Opera forever. Those beeps are my metronome. :ok_hand:
Sara: Headphone symphony, pls. Also FYI there's a rogue bagel in the fridge labeled 'maybe mine'. :eyes:
Ryan: I vote Microwave Opera AND claim the bagel. Whoever left it without a Post-it surrender the rights. Free coffee to the winner. :coffee:
dev-bot: Reminder: deploy scheduled in 2 hours. (unrelated but important) :robot_face:
Lee: One-liner: 'If the microwave sings, we all get free popcorn.' :popcorn:
Amy: +1 to the Post-it bagel policy. Also proposing a microwave karaoke slot next Friday 12:30-12:45 — low stakes, high beeps. :raised_hands:
Maya: @Amy love that. Microwave karaoke accepted. Theme suggestions? I nominate 80s power ballads. :guitar:
Ben: Theme suggestion: 'elevator music tribute' — low commitment, maximal mysteriousness. :laughing:
Ellie: 'Tiny triumphant beep' becomes our new ringtone. Also quick kudos to @Sara for the plant rescue yesterday. :seedling:
Sara: Thanks @Ellie! Plant's name is now 'Chad'. He seems pleased. :herb:
Maya: Tally so far: Microwave Opera 4, Headphone Symphony 2, Abstain 1. Not binding but ceremonial. See you at karaoke? :tada:
